posts.title: I love AI!
posts.description: Intro There are a lot of pros and cons to any new technology. In the end, after numerous discussions about the consequences, morality, costs, benefits, it all boils down to how you feel about it. Me? I love AI. And that's part of the problem. posts.title: AI: utility or google search. Can't be both
posts.description: There are two main narratives related to Artificial Intelligence. One is that it will become a new kind of utility, raw intelligence used by token or whatever unit of measure will apply, just like water or electricity are billed on volume. posts.title: Globalisation Horror
posts.description: H. P. Lovecraft was a weird dude, but through his writing he influenced so many others. Probably a reflection of his own chronic inadequacy, racism and xenophobia, he became the master of what was dubbed "cosmic horror", a type of absolute dread that comes from knowing you are powerless against indifferent strange things that could smash you as easily as you do an ant.
